E.  NEW BUSINESS

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that Saturday, May 11th is the
scholarship dinner; May 17th is a 6th Grade Fun Day at Fedde Middle School; May 22nd is the Mayor
Youth Walk Achevement; May 27th is the Memorial Day Event; and that the Clarkdale Summer Camp
registration is now open.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that there is a Catalytic Converter Engraving Event on
May 15th, at Alex Tires.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that May 18 Free Tire Collection Program; and
that the City started the Carson and Norwalk Blvd Traffic Signal Improvement.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula appreciation towards staff, visited field yesterday and volunteers; visited
